def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def components(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or not g[y][x]: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                    stack+= [(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps

def stamp_copy(grid, pat, top, marker):
    """Copy pattern (rows of bbox values, marker=(r,c) within bbox) so its marker lands on cell top; marker cell becomes 0."""
    h,w=len(pat),len(pat[0]); r0,c0=top[0]-marker[0], top[1]-marker[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            y,x=r0+r,c0+c
            if 0<=y<len(out) and 0<=x<len(out[0]):
                out[y][x]=0 if (r,c)==marker else pat[r][c]
    return out

def transform(grid, marker_rel=None):
    comps=components(grid)
    big=max(comps,key=len)
    cells={(i,j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j]}
    fives=[c for c in cells if grid[c[0]][c[1]]==5]
    pattern_fives=[c for c in fives if c in set(big)]
    lone=[c for c in fives if c not in set(big)]
    rs=[c[0] for c in big]; cs=[c[1] for c in big]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); h,w=max(rs)-r0+1,max(cs)-c0+1
    pat=[[grid[r0+r][c0+c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    if pattern_fives:
        m=(pattern_fives[0][0]-r0, pattern_fives[0][1]-c0)
    else:
        m=marker_rel  # marker gap given externally (test case: blank gap in pattern)
    out=grid
    for f in lone:
        out=stamp_copy(out, pat, f, m)
    return out

lib_add='''def components(grid):
    """The 4-connected components of nonzero cells, each as a list of (row, col)."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or not grid[y][x]: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                    stack+= [(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps

def stamp_copy(grid, pat, top, marker):
    """Copy pattern (bbox rows, marker=(r,c) in bbox) so the marker cell lands on top; the marker cell becomes 0 in the copy."""
    h,w=len(pat),len(pat[0]); r0,c0=top[0]-marker[0], top[1]-marker[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            y,x=r0+r,c0+c
            if 0<=y<len(out) and 0<=x<len(out[0]):
                out[y][x]=0 if (r,c)==marker else pat[r][c]
    return out

def bbox(grid, cells):
    """The bounding box of cells as (top, left, height, width)."""
    rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    return min(rs),min(cs),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1

def stamp_on_fives(grid):
    """Copy the pattern (the component whose 5 marker touches colored cells) onto every lone 5, marker aligned to it and blanked."""
    comps=components(grid)
    fives=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    lone={f for f in fives if not any(0<=f[0]+a<len(grid) and 0<=f[1]+b<len(grid[0]) and grid[f[0]+a][f[1]+b] not in (0,5) for a,b in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))}
    pat_cells=set()
    for comp in comps:
        if not any(c in lone for c in comp):
            pat_cells|=set(comp)
    t,l,h,w=bbox(grid,pat_cells)
    pat=[[grid[t+r][l+c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    m=next((f[0]-t,f[1]-l) for f in fives if f in pat_cells)
    out=grid
    for f in lone: out=stamp_copy(out,pat,f,m)
    return out
'''
